title.zh-CN: 阴茎增大与声音变粗 · 8岁4月男孩
title.en: Penile growth and deepening voice · boy aged 8 years 4 months

summary.zh-CN: 快速男性化与既往发育落后并存，需要区分中枢和外周激素来源。
summary.en: Rapid virilisation accompanies earlier developmental delay; distinguish central from peripheral hormone sources.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：用激素刺激模式区分中枢与外周来源。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：完整肿瘤组织分级、长期影像和生育内分泌转归；原文部分AFP单位异常未改写为标准值。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Use stimulation patterns to distinguish central and peripheral sources. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Full tumour grading, long-term imaging and reproductive/endocrine outcomes; questionable source AFP units are not silently normalised. Check understanding through teach-back.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 完整肿瘤组织分级、长期影像和生育内分泌转归；原文部分AFP单位异常未改写为标准值。
unknowns.en: Full tumour grading, long-term imaging and reproductive/endocrine outcomes; questionable source AFP units are not silently normalised.

references: 张红红, 崔继华, 祁建勤, 李梅蕊, 吴建敏, 凌昱. 先天性睾丸发育不全综合征伴纵隔畸胎瘤、外周性性早熟一例. 中华儿科杂志. 2013;51(08):630-630. doi:10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1310.2013.08.016.
